summary: This bill amends the Federal Credit Union Act to exclude loans made to veterans from the definition of member business loans for credit unions.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends the Federal Credit Union Act to exclude loans to veterans from the definition of member business loans, allowing credit unions greater flexibility in lending. It does not authorize, appropriate, or alter any federal government expenditures or budgets.
The bill contains no provisions related to taxes, tax rates, deductions, credits, or revenue collection.
The bill addresses credit union lending definitions and has no connection to healthcare policy, coverage, or markets.
No provisions in the bill relate to firearms, regulations, or gun rights.
The bill makes no changes to immigration law, pathways, enforcement, or protections.
No content in the bill addresses reproductive rights or abortion access.
While the bill references veterans, it concerns private credit union lending rules rather than military budgets, defense spending, or armed forces policy.
The bill has no environmental, regulatory, or climate-related provisions.
The legislation facilitates business credit access for veterans through credit unions but does not expand, contract, or modify any federal welfare, entitlement, or safety-net programs.
No provisions address schools, education funding, or school choice.
The bill does not touch on drug enforcement, decriminalization, or related regulations.
No references to sentencing, policing, rehabilitation, or criminal justice reforms.
The bill contains nothing related to trade agreements, tariffs, or globalization.
No fiscal provisions affecting deficits, debt reduction, or government borrowing.
The bill does not address legal protections or rights for LGBTQ+ individuals.
No provisions concerning foreign assistance or international aid.
The bill makes no changes to voting access, election procedures, or integrity measures.
No content related to technology regulation, data privacy, or oversight of tech companies.
The bill does not address worker protections, union rights, or employer flexibility.
No provisions involving religious exemptions or civil rights enforcement.
